import{useEffect,useRef}from'react';export default function useReveal(){const ref=useRef(null);useEffect(()=>{const el=ref.current;if(!el)return;const targets=el.querySelectorAll('.reveal');const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(e=>{if(!e.isIntersecting)return;// stagger siblings
const siblings=[...e.target.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.reveal:not(.in)')];const idx=siblings.indexOf(e.target);setTimeout(()=>e.target.classList.add('in'),idx*80);obs.unobserve(e.target);});},{threshold:0.1});targets.forEach(t=>obs.observe(t));return()=>obs.disconnect();},[]);return ref;}
